entries.title: SERPENT
entries.author: John French
entries.currentBlurb: The Alpha Legion weaves its schemes within schemes, operating in the shadows with motives known only to themselves.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: An Alpha Legion tale of deception and hidden agendas during the Heresy.

entries.title: HUNTER'S MOON
entries.author: Guy Haley
entries.currentBlurb: A White Scars hunting mission during the Heresy, showcasing the V Legion's swift and deadly warfare style.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: White Scars warriors conduct a hunt, demonstrating their mastery of fast-strike warfare.

entries.title: THIEF OF REVELATIONS
entries.author: Graham McNeill
entries.currentBlurb: The Thousand Sons seek forbidden knowledge, stealing secrets that may doom or save them.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Thousand Sons sorcerers pursue dangerous knowledge in their quest for understanding.

entries.title: VERITAS FERRUM
entries.author: David Annandale
entries.currentBlurb: The Iron Hands' philosophy of flesh's weakness is tested in the aftermath of their Primarch's death.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Iron Hands warriors grapple with their Legion's doctrine after losing their Primarch at Isstvan.

entries.title: STRIKE AND FADE
entries.author: Guy Haley
entries.currentBlurb: Raven Guard survivors employ hit-and-run tactics against superior traitor forces.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Shattered Raven Guard warriors use guerrilla warfare tactics in their fight against the traitors.

entries.title: BROTHERHOOD OF THE STORM
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: The White Scars must choose their allegiance as the Heresy divides the galaxy. The V Legion's isolation has kept them from the conflict, but now they must decide whether to follow Horus or remain loyal to the Emperor.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The White Scars face a critical choice as news of the Heresy reaches them, forcing the V Legion to decide their allegiance in the civil war.

entries.title: HONOUR TO THE DEAD
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: Ultramarines honor their fallen brothers while seeking vengeance for betrayal.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Ultramarines pay tribute to their dead while pursuing justice for the Word Bearers' treachery.

entries.title: BUTCHER'S NAILS
entries.author: Aaron Dembski-Bowden
entries.currentBlurb: The tragic bond between Angron and Lorgar, as the Word Bearers Primarch tries to understand the World Eaters' cursed existence with the Butcher's Nails.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Lorgar attempts to understand Angron's suffering and the curse of the Butcher's Nails that drives the World Eaters.

entries.title: KRYPTOS
entries.author: Graham McNeill
entries.currentBlurb: Secrets and forbidden knowledge on Mars during the Mechanicum's civil war.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: A tale of hidden knowledge and dangerous secrets during Mars's schism.

entries.title: WOLF'S CLAW
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: Space Wolves unleash their savage fury in the Emperor's name during the Heresy.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The VI Legion demonstrates their ferocity as they fight for the Emperor against the traitors.

entries.title: WARMASTER
entries.author: John French
entries.currentBlurb: A glimpse into Horus's command and the weight of leading the rebellion against the Emperor.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: An exploration of Horus's role as Warmaster and the burden of leading the rebellion.

entries.title: THE DIVINE WORD
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: Word Bearers spread their dark faith across the galaxy, converting or destroying all who resist.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XVII Legion preaches their corrupted faith, forcing conversion or death upon those they encounter.

entries.title: KHÂRN: THE EIGHTFOLD PATH
entries.author: Anthony Reynolds
entries.currentBlurb: Khârn walks the path to damnation, his descent into bloodlust accelerating as the Heresy rages.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Khârn's transformation continues as he descends further into violence and rage.

entries.title: CYPHER: GUARDIAN OF ORDER
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: The mysterious warrior who would become Cypher serves the Dark Angels during the Heresy.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: A Dark Angels warrior serves his Legion during the Heresy, on a path that will lead to legend and mystery.

entries.title: HEART OF THE CONQUEROR
entries.author: Aaron Dembski-Bowden
entries.currentBlurb: Aboard the Conqueror, the World Eaters' flagship, the Legion's descent into madness accelerates.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Life aboard the World Eaters' flagship reveals the XII Legion's transformation into mindless berserkers.

entries.title: LUCIUS: THE ETERNAL BLADEMASTER
entries.author: Graham McNeill
entries.currentBlurb: Lucius pursues perfection in swordsmanship, his pride and skill marking him for damnation.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The master swordsman Lucius seeks perfection in combat, driven by pride and the pursuit of supremacy.

entries.title: CENSURE
entries.author: Nick Kyme
entries.currentBlurb: Salamanders face judgment and condemnation as the Heresy forces hard choices upon them.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Salamanders warriors confront difficult decisions and consequences during the civil war.

entries.title: BJORN: LONE WOLF
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: The warrior who would become the Fell-Handed fights during the Heresy, earning his legendary status.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: A Space Wolves warrior fights alone during the Heresy, beginning his path to becoming a legend.

entries.title: RIVEN
entries.author: John French
entries.currentBlurb: A tale of division and broken bonds as the Heresy tears warriors apart.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Heresy's divisions tear apart bonds of brotherhood and loyalty.
